alex: Hey team — seeing streaming responses cut off mid-JSON after our client does a token refresh. finish_reason never arrives and client sees an incomplete object. Repro steps below, minimal curl capture attached.

maria_support: Can you paste the request_id/trace-id from the headers and a small response capture? Also which SDK/version?

alex: request-id: rwd-req-20260215-9a2b, sdk: js-client v1.4.2. Curl capture (truncated response):
```
$ curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TEMP\" \\n  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/chat?model=rw-infer-2
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: text/event-stream
...
data: {\"id\":\"tok_abc\",\"delta\":\"Hello w\"}

data: {\"delta\":\"orld\",\"finish_reason\":null}

# connection closed by server here (no final event)
```

jordan_engineer: Quick hypothesis: client rotates token mid-stream (refresh flow returns new token), auth middleware triggers an upstream 401/reauth attempt or proxy closes the socket, and the server-side stream terminates without emitting the final SSE 'data:' with finish token. Two possible failure modes: (1) server runtime drops outbound buffer when socket ECONNRESET occurs and doesn't flush final sentinel, (2) an edge/proxy (Fastly/CloudFlare) handles the reauth and tears TLS connection early.

alex: We only refresh in client when 401 returned; but our SDK preemptively refreshes ~2s before expiry. Sometimes that overlaps with active stream. Observed frequency ~3% across long-running chat sessions.

maria_support: Can you reproduce deterministically? If so, run with DEBUG=rw:stream and capture the full wire (including request headers from client and last 1KB from server). Also include client reconnect behavior (does it re-open with Range or resume header?).

alex: I reproduced locally. Client flow:
- open SSE with token A
- at t+7s, client requests refresh, gets token B
- SDK swaps bearer header in-place and performs a quiet reconnect (opens new connection) while holding previous stream open
- previous stream sees socket FIN from proxy -> truncated stream
We do not send any Range header, client just opens a new stream. Attached raw tail (hex):
```
2c 7b 22 69 64 22 3a 22 74 6f 6b 5f 31 22 2c 22 64 65 6c 74 61 22 3a 22 6f 6f 70
# partial JSON stops mid-token
```

jordan_engineer: Ok. Can you collect the edge/proxy logs (frontend LB) for rwd-req-20260215-9a2b? I want to see whether the backend returned 200 then connection closed, or the edge injected a RST. If it's the backend, runtime will need a fix to attempt to flush final sentinel on EOF. If edge dropped it, fallback is to teach SDK to signal EOF semantics: server should send an explicit 'event: done' sentinel and client should treat missing sentinel as retriable with resume semantics.

deploy-bot: rollout redwood/runtime@2026-02-16 -> prod started (canary 10%) :rocket:

alex: Edge logs: frontend shows 200 -> client TLS close -> backend did not log final flush. Backend runtime logs show \"stream aborted by client connection close\" around the same timestamp. No explicit exception thrown.

jordan_engineer: That matches runtime dropping output on ECONNRESET. Short-term mitigation: SDK change to avoid simultaneous reconnects; ensure old stream is properly closed only after final sentinel seen or small read timeout. Long-term: runtime should attempt to write final chunk or set a short grace period to flush outbound buffer when socket closure is graceful. I'll open an eng-issue.

sre_bot: Created issue RW-ISSUE-4589: runtime should retry/flush final SSE sentinel on client disconnect during auth rotation. Added priority=P2.

maria_support: For now, recommend customers: (1) upgrade SDK to v1.4.3 (patch: serialized refresh during an active stream), (2) implement client-side resume logic (idempotent streams with conversation ids), (3) if using managed proxy, enable sticky connections to reduce mid-stream reauth overlap.

sam_prod: Noted a customer on Dedicated who hit this in prod. Deploying SDK patch to their app now. Please post postmortem once root cause confirmed.

alex: Thanks — will test v1.4.3 and report. If anyone needs the full pcap I can upload privately. :+1:

jordan_engineer: Follow-up action items:
- eng/runtime: add flush-on-eof + telemetry for truncated streams (assigned to @jordan)
- devex/sdk: release v1.4.3 with serialized refresh during streams (assigned to @maria_support)
- support: notify affected customers and offer workaround (assigned to @maria_support)

maria_support: Escalated to eng-runtime and SDK teams. Tracking in RW-ISSUE-4589.
